# Code Review Checklist

- [ ] Buffer bounds are correct.
- [ ] Input return values are checked.
- [ ] NUL termination is preserved.
- [ ] Character classification uses unsigned-char conversion.
- [ ] No unsafe string functions are introduced.
- [ ] EOF and long-line behavior are defined.
- [ ] Exit semantics are tested.
- [ ] Compiler warnings are resolved.
- [ ] Tests and docs reflect behavior.
- [ ] No unrelated binary artifacts are included.
